eps.d: Jeremy Brown starts his new job as the teacher of English as a Foreign Language class, and meets his students for the first time. A diverse group of ten foreign adult students in London, hailing from nine different countries. The Europeans consist of two au pairs, the flirtatious and beautiful Danielle (France) and prim and proper Anna (Germany); two young single men, Giovanni (Italy) and Max…
An education inspector arrives at the school to observe the classes, but Mr. Brown mistakes him for a new foreign student.
Ranjeet asks Mr. Brown to help him escape an arranged marriage.
Concerned that his students' English is not improving, Mr. Brown keeps them after class--so late that they are locked in.

Jamila is arrested for shoplifting a magazine due to her misunderstanding the term "free" in promotional material. However, Mr. Brown and Ali later discover that Jamila has shoplifted many other items in the past. Mr. Brown and his students then work together to return the stolen items without being noticed.

It's Mr. Brown's birthday and everyone in the class has brought him a present. However, it's not all happy returns when Ms. Courtney informs Mr. Brown that his trial month is over and she is not satisfied with his teaching. However, she finds out that the new teacher is taking over the school and brings Mr. Brown back.

In order to see how prepared they are for their upcoming exam, the students prepare to take a mock exam. But when the students see that their teacher has no faith in them, they decide to cheat in order to ace the exam and prove their progress.

eps.t: Better to Have Loved and Lost
eps.d: Ali and Su Li surprise the class when they announce that they're getting married. But Mr. Brown gets a much bigger shock when he finds out that Ali is already married and plans to take Su Li as his second wife.

Mr. Brown becomes ill and cannot come to class, so, Ms. Courtney takes charge. However, the student's English is not up to her expectations, so she sends them away. They all pay a visit to Mr. Brown, each with their own 'remedy' to make him feel better.

Juan brings his Russian sailor friend Boris, who has come to England to escape Russia, to Mr. Brown's class. Boris explains that he wants to stay in England to be with his English girlfriend. Everything seems to be going all right until the captain of a Russian ship comes to the classroom looking for his roaming sailor.

Mr. Brown finds himself in a lot of trouble when Danielle tells Mr. Jarvis, a pestering Irish woodwork teacher at the school, that she is engaged to Mr. Brown. He soon finds himself running around the school in an attempt to squash the rumour, only to leave wrong impressions and ending up in the school gymnasium to box against the philandering teacher.

At the beginning of the lesson, Mr. Brown asks the students to speak aloud for one minute on various topics. The class learns that Taro's childhood was very lonely because he never knew his parents. Mr. Brown sympathizes by telling the class the story of how he was left on an orphanage in Jeremy Street when he was a baby 30 years ago and therefore grew up without any parents as well. However Mr.
The students prepare to take their Lower Cambridge Certificate exam at the end of the first term. Mr. Brown has an encounter with a couple in the bar which might just come back to haunt him.
In the new school year, Mr. Brown has two new students, Ingrid and Zoltan. However, ten familiar faces who did not pass their exams return.
It is announced that the Queen will be visiting the school, and Ms. Courtney gets overexcited about the event.
Ms. Courtney is reunited with an old boyfriend whose intentions may not be pure.
Ranjeet has been saving up his money to visit his mother for her birthday, but Mr. Brown loses it and the class works to get it back.
Mr. Brown and his students are stranded in the countryside when their field-trip bus breaks down.
Mr. Brown agrees to spend the night in Giovanni and Max's apartment while his is being painted.
Ms. Courtney forces Mr. Brown to attend a charity dance, and he has to decide who to escort.
The class have to prepare for the school's talent show. In the end, the class sings the Mind Your Language opening theme.
An affluent Arabian Sheikh enrolls his Scottish chauffeur in Mr Brown's class, who causes trouble for all the students.
Danielle, who is an au pair, brings her boss' baby to class.
Mr. Brown breaks his leg and is hospitalized. When Juan telephones the hospital, a miscommunication results in Juan thinking that Mr. Brown has died.
Mr. Brown is offered a new highly paid job at another school and leaves immediately, only to learn that the offer has been withdrawn.
All the students are brought to court for causing mischief in public. Ms. Courtney oversees the session, while Mr. Brown acts as their barrister.
Anna's au-pair visa is set to expire; the others decide that she should marry Mr. Brown to become a British citizen.
The school holds a fete, and Max is held responsible for hiring Arthur Mullard.
Ali suspects that his wife is having an affair. Mr. Brown follows Ali's wife and finds that she is going to Ranjeet's house.
Mr Brown mistakenly believes that Miss Courtney is dying.
Two crooks rob the shop of Ranjeet's cousin when he is in charge. To evade capture, they hide in the school.
The students have seven draws on the football pools and stand to win thousands of pounds if they can get one more!
It's Miss Courtney's birthday, and finding Ingrid's mink coat in her office, she assumes that it's a present...
Mr Brown finds himself in deep water when he takes the students down the River Thames to improve their knowledge of English history.
Mr Brown scoffs at the suggestion that the school is haunted.
Giovanni's mother visits him at the school.
Mr Brown and all the students catch a rash and fever, and soon they are admitted to a quarantine ward.
Juan is accidentally locked in the school on the night before his wedding!
There is discontent when the students form their own union.
Mr Brown is suffering from flu and has a bizarre dream involving destruction at the school.
Mr Brown brings his neighbour's dog to class.
The school is closed and Miss Courtney is busy preparing for a European tour, while Mr Brown and the students arrive to find out how they have fared in their examinations.
